bridge_nodes.name: Devrat Sharma
bridge_nodes.centrality_role: High betweenness centrality broker bridging NCR cyber syndicate (Case 018) with Mumbai hawala ring (Case 041).

bridge_evidence.relationship: Collects funds from Case 018 mule accounts (TXN-1007, 1008, 1009, 1010) on 11-JUN-2026 into ACC-7702.
bridge_evidence.cross_case_bridge_transfer: Transfers INR 50,00,000 via TXN_552 (TXN-1011) on 07-AUG-2026 into Apex Trade Solutions ACC-7701 (Case 041).
bridge_evidence.telephony_bridge: Calls Tariq Merchant PH-1005 (CDR-1008) and Anita D'Souza PH-1007 (CDR-1010).

chronological_reconstruction_events.narration: Unauthorized spear-phishing RTGS transfer: Zenith Corporate account ACC-1001 debited for INR 1,00,00,000 into Suman Roy mule account ACC-2201.
Layering tranche: Account ACC-2201 disperses INR 1.0 Crore across five secondary accounts (ACC-3301, ACC-3302, ACC-3303, ACC-3304, ACC-8809).
graph_delta: Edges: TRANSFERRED to all 5 mule accounts

chronological_reconstruction_events.narration: Aggregation: Mule accounts transfer INR 70,00,000 into Broker Devrat Sharma's account ACC-7702.
Telephony cross-connect: Devrat Sharma (Gurugram/Mumbai) coordinates with Hawala operative Tariq Merchant in Mumbai.
Signature Cross-Case Link: Devrat Sharma executes TXN_552 sending INR 50,00,000 to shell company Apex Trade Solutions (ACC-7701).
graph_delta: Edge: ACC-7702 -[TRANSFERRED]-> ACC-7701 (Crosses Case 018 to Case 041)

chronological_reconstruction_events.narration: Rapid shell dissipation: Anita D'Souza routes INR 45,00,000 from Apex Trade ACC-7701 to Tariq Merchant ACC-7703.
Offshore Hawala exit: Tariq Merchant transfers INR 10,00,00,000 via SWIFT wire to Farooq Sheikh in Dubai for bullion clearing.

intentional_contradictions.title: Alibi Contradiction - Rajesh Verma Physical Location
intentional_contradictions.description: In written police interrogation statement, suspect Rajesh Verma stated he was in Mumbai attending a wedding during the heist on 09-JUN-2026. However, CDR-1002 and CDR-1007 record his phone PH-1001 connected to Cell Tower T-4401 in Gurugram Sector 44 during the exact commission of the wire fraud.

conflicting_sources.claim: Active on Tower T-4401 Sector 44 Gurugram at 11:20:00 IST

intentional_contradictions.investigative_action: Issue formal request for cell tower triangulation and CCTV retrieval at Sector 44 intersection.

intentional_contradictions.title: Beneficiary Account KYC vs. NetBanking Login IP
intentional_contradictions.description: Beneficiary account ACC-3304 is registered under branch MI Road Jaipur with residential address in Rajasthan. However, web transaction authentication IP 203.0.113.88 maps directly to cyber hideout LOC-101 / LOC-102 in Gurugram/Noida.

conflicting_sources.source: Cyber Indicator IND-104 & Core Banking Session Log

intentional_contradictions.investigative_action: Subpoena ISP session logs and examine remote desktop / proxy tool usage on DEV-102.

investigation_gaps.title: Unidentified Beneficiary Account Owner
investigation_gaps.description: Account ACC-8809 at Federal Union Bank received INR 25,00,000 from the initial heist proceeds (TXN-1006). The account_holder_id is NULL as the account was opened using forged voter identification that does not correspond to any verified national identity.
investigation_gaps.recommended_step: Issue Section 91 CrPC / Section 94 BNSS notice to Federal Union Bank for branch video CCTV and account opening biometric logs.

investigation_gaps.title: Unattributed Burner Phone Number in Heist Coordination
investigation_gaps.description: MSISDN +919811009988 had multiple short-duration calls with broker Devrat Sharma (CDR-1005) immediately after fund transfers, and received activation SMS from SIM box DEV-105 (CDR-1014). The registered_owner_id is NULL.
investigation_gaps.status: Unresolved Link to SIM Box Ring
investigation_gaps.recommended_step: Cross-reference IMEI 358941098239908 against seized inventory in Case 059 (Operation DarkSIM).
